companies.name: Meridian Foods Corp
companies.business_overview: Meridian operates in packaged consumer foods, generating revenue primarily through branded retail distribution. Headquartered in the US, reports under GAAP.

agreement.explanation: Rule-based (86%) and trained model (89%) confidence independently converge on a low-risk read. This reinforces the conclusion rather than requiring further investigation.

companies.valuation_standing: EV/EBITDA of 11.2x sits in the top quartile of its peer cluster, suggesting the market already prices in strong fundamentals.
risk_factors: Elevated customer concentration in top retail account
Input-cost exposure to a single commodity category
companies.conclusion: Meridian presents a financially sound profile with strong, cash-backed profitability and manageable leverage. Both assessments independently support a high-confidence, low-distress standing — diligence should focus on customer concentration, not balance-sheet risk.
